question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

OUTRAGED
solution: Here the correct answer is **Angry**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given word:- • **Outraged **- arouse fierce anger, shock, or indignation in (someone). ((किसी) में भयंकर क्रोध, सदमा या आक्रोश पैदा करना) • For Example - The public was **outraged **at the brutality involved. • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in options:- • **Absurd **- wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate. (बेतहाशा अनुचित, अतार्किक या अनुचित) • **Angry **- feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger. (झुंझलाहट, नाराजगी या शत्रुता महसूस करना या दिखाना; क्रोध से भरा हुआ) • **Content **- in a state of peaceful happiness. (शांतिपूर्ण खुशी की स्थिति में) • **Satisfied **- contented; pleased. (संतुष्ट; प्रसन्न) • Thus, after looking at the meanings of the given words, it is clear that the correct **synonym **for '**outraged**' is '**angry**'. • Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.** 31:Tf3d, The correct answer is '**health**'.
